path.title: AP1 apron: P1 rehearsal, measured: a 3-line connector ribbon cannot end on the convex, graded outer edge of the College/Navajo corner across the R 30 return: its end row hovers 2.9-4.0 cm over the loop deck between its three points wherever the centre stands (the weld self-check and verify_mouths allow 2 cm), and the mitre's straight run-on lands the NE end at ~v1523, not at the return's v1527.5. The stub is welded with Waring's straight curbs (1.7-1.8 cm); the return's area is this apron, a P3 authored piece (EXPANSION-PLAN P1 note)
